t: This Act may be cited as the “Military Appropriation Act, 1948”.

fable.w: This section only gives the short title of the Act. The one possible temptation is that an appropriations act might elsewhere involve outside parties, but nothing in this text provides for consultation, hearings, rulemaking, advisory bodies, or a right to sue. No party outside the federal government is involved in any federal decision here.

qwen_block.w: This section is a standard short title provision. It merely assigns a name to the legislation for citation purposes and does not establish any process for consultation, coordination, or participation with outside parties.
qwen_block.s: This Act may be cited as the “Military Appropriation Act, 1948”.

opus.w: This section only gives the Act a short title. It sets up no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with outside parties, or right to sue. Nothing else in the section relates to participation, so the label is No.
